title: Thinking on Podcasts & How We Listen
summary: Kahran and Divya compare how they actually consume podcasts — Divya cycles between a heavy/journalistic/fiction/light loop, Kahran binges Matt Walker three episodes deep — and use that to ask what audiences expect from a show like theirs. It opens up into broader media habits — reading four books in parallel, when comedy can be a flow state, and whether their own podcast needs more thematic continuity to land.
topics: how people actually listen to podcasts
cycling between heavy and light media
audience expectations of a media format

intents.display: to think about how listeners actually move through podcasts and media
